en.hubeali:
Ali, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Jameel Bin Salih, from Muhammad Bin Marwan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Myasws fatherasws was saying: ‘And which thing is more delighting to myasws eyes than the dissimulation (Taqiyya). The dissimulation (Taqiyya) is a shield of the Momin’.
en.sarwar: 14. Ali has narrated from his father from ibn Mahbub from Jamil ibn Salih from Muhammad ibn Marwan from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
My father (a.s.) has said, ‘What could be more delightful to me than al-Taqiyyah’, it is a shield for believing people.’”
